verdict.rationale: Fenwick documents AI tools that generate insights from legal data (case-law relevance discovery from briefs, automated contract-provision extraction/summarization) and real-time dashboards, but these are used by attorneys/staff rather than exposed directly to the end-user inside a client-facing product interface like the trademark extranet. Missing for 10: evidence that AI-generated insights/suggestions are surfaced directly within a client-facing product (e.g., the extranet or portal) rather than as an internal attorney tool, and any independent corroboration of these AI features' actual use/impact.
